metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin that validates business ideas with a team of 6 specialized agents running in parallel, then returns a GO/PIVOT/KILL verdict.

plugins.name: agentic-business-validator
plugins.description: Validate a business idea by running it through a team of 6 specialized agents in parallel (Market Scout, Skeptic, Customer, Strategist, Financials, Architect), then a cross-fire round where they challenge each other, ending in a GO/PIVOT/KILL verdict and a business plan for ideas that survive.
